Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used both DDA (for spectral library generation) and DIA (for quantification) modes. The primary enrichment was a pull-down (AP-MS) using Twin-Strep-tags. While the study discusses phosphorylation mutants (Y223F, Y248F), these were genetic substitutions to study interaction changes, not a phospho-peptide enrichment workflow.

scope: High-throughput analysis of PD-1 interacting proteins was performed using a pull-down assay and quantitative mass spectrometry proteomic analysis.
PD-1-bound proteins were washed three times and eluted in 75 ¼l of 1X reducing Laemmli buffer by boiling for 2 min at 95 °C. Eluted samples were further used for LC–MS/MS

The PD-1 interacting proteins were isolated through PD-1 pull-down performed in U2OS cells overexpressing PD-1 protein fused with V5 and Twin-Strep tags. The interacting proteins were purified on StrepTactin magnetic beads and eluted into SDS reducing buffer.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was specifically the PD-1 protein complex isolated via affinity pull-down (StrepTactin beads), not the whole cell lysate.
